# Assessment Overview

This folder contains supplementary assessment fact documents generated during analysis.

- [architecture-diagram.md](architecture-diagram.md) - High-level and component-level architecture diagrams.
- [dependency-map.md](dependency-map.md) - External dependency map grouped by functional categories.
- [api-service-contracts.md](api-service-contracts.md) - Service catalog, API endpoint contracts, and communication patterns.
- [data-architecture.md](data-architecture.md) - Database configuration, entity relationships, and persistence boundaries.
- [configuration-inventory.md](configuration-inventory.md) - Configuration sources, profiles, secrets handling, and runtime settings.
- [business-workflows.md](business-workflows.md) - Primary business workflows, rules, and sequence diagram.
